# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Figure 6 and Figure S11/S12

Data analysis scripts for re-creating Figure 6 and Figure S11/S12. 

# Software requirements

```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(conflicted)
library(CMScaller)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(dittoSeq)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(readxl)
library(scran)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::count)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)

```

# Read data

```{r}
## Clinical trial datasets
JAVELIN_SE <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_JAVELIN_SE.rds") 
IMmotion_SE <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_IMmotion_SE.rds") 
Checkmate_SE <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_Checkmate_SE.rds") 

## TCGA KIRC objects 
TCGA_SE <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_TCGAKIRC_SE.rds")

## Other
gene_signatures <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_genesignatures.rds") 
POORUP <- gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_poor
FAVUP <- gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_favorable
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))
comp_surv <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_molsub_comp.xlsx", sheet = 1) 
comp_IO <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_molsub_comp.xlsx", sheet = 2) 
```

# Figure 6 

## 6A

```{r}
# Perform nearest template prediction for survival ecotypes in JAVELIN 101
## Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(JAVELIN_SE)$tpm
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat_JAV <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat_JAV) <- rowData(JAVELIN_SE)$gene

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(FAVUP) <- rep("FAV", length(FAVUP))
names(POORUP) <- rep("POOR", length(POORUP))
keyup <- c(FAVUP, POORUP)
template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
set.seed(22)
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat_JAV,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  doPlot = FALSE
)

# Step 4: Convert predictions into groups
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(JAVELIN_SE$UUID, ntp_out$PID)]
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "POOR"] <- "Poor"
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "NOT"] <- "Medium"
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "FAV"] <- "Favorable"

# Step 5: Show survival trends
# Combined
surv_out <- colData(JAVELIN_SE) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(UUID, OS, OS_CNSR, PFS, PFS_CNSR, survival_ecotype_gene) %>% unique()

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS, OS_CNSR) ~ survival_ecotype_gene, data = surv_out)
ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3","#CA0020"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)

fit <- survfit(Surv(PFS, PFS_CNSR) ~ survival_ecotype_gene, data = surv_out)
ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3","#CA0020"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```

## 6B

```{r}
# MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL 
## Treatment benefit for survival ecotypes

# 1. OS 
Cox_df <- as.data.frame(colData(JAVELIN_SE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(UUID, survival_ecotype_gene, Treatment, Tumor_Location) %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("TKI", "IO+VEGF")),
    OS_months = JAVELIN_SE$OS[match(UUID, JAVELIN_SE$UUID)],
    status_OS = JAVELIN_SE$OS_CNSR[match(UUID, JAVELIN_SE$UUID)]
  )
tme_groups <- unique(Cox_df$survival_ecotype_gene)
cox_results <- lapply(tme_groups, function(group) {
  df_group <- Cox_df %>% filter(survival_ecotype_gene == group & !is.na(Treatment))
  model <- coxph(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ Treatment, data = df_group)
  summary(model)
  })
names(cox_results) <- tme_groups
plot_df_prop <- rbind(data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[1]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3), 
                      type = names(cox_results[1])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[2]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[2])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[3]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[3]))
)

ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(type,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR (OS) for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

# 2. PFS
Cox_df <- as.data.frame(colData(JAVELIN_SE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(UUID, survival_ecotype_gene, Treatment, Tumor_Location) %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("TKI", "IO+VEGF")),
```

## 6C

```{r}
#ORR
se_sub <- JAVELIN_SE[, JAVELIN_SE$ORR %in% c("PR", "PD", "CR")]
se_sub$ORR_comb <- ifelse(se_sub$ORR == "PD", "PD", "PR/CR")

df <- as.data.frame(colData(se_sub)[!is.na(se_sub$survival_ecotype_gene), c("Treatment", "ORR_comb", "survival_ecotype_gene")])
fisher_out <- c(paste0("Medium p = ",fisher.test(table(df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Medium",]$Treatment, df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Medium",]$ORR_comb))$p, "Poor p = ",fisher.test(table(df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Poor",]$Treatment, df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Poor",]$ORR_comb))$p, "Favorable p = ",fisher.test(table(df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Favorable",]$Treatment, df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Favorable",]$ORR_comb))$p))

dittoBarPlot(se_sub, var = "ORR_comb", group.by = "Treatment", split.by = "survival_ecotype_gene")+
  ggtitle(fisher_out)+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

## 6D

```{r}
# Nearest template prediction
# Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(IMmotion_SE)$tpm
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat_IM <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat_IM) <- rowData(IMmotion_SE)$gene

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(FAVUP) <- rep("FAV", length(FAVUP))
names(POORUP) <- rep("POOR", length(POORUP))
keyup <- c(FAVUP, POORUP)
template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
set.seed(22)
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat_IM,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  doPlot = FALSE
)

# Step 4: Convert predictions into groups
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))
IMmotion_SE$PID <- IMmotion_SE$RNASEQ_SAMPLE_ID
IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(IMmotion_SE$PID, ntp_out$PID)]
IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "POOR"] <- "Poor"
IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "NOT"] <- "Medium"
IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[IMmotion_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "FAV"] <- "Favorable"

# Step 5: Show survival trends
# Combined
surv_out <- colData(IMmotion_SE) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, PFS_MONTHS, PFS_CENSOR, survival_ecotype_gene) %>% unique()
fit <- survfit(Surv(PFS_MONTHS, PFS_CENSOR) ~ survival_ecotype_gene, data = surv_out)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3","#CA0020"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    arm = factor(Arm, levels = c("EVEROLISMUS", "NIVOLUMAB")),
    PFS_months = Checkmate_SE$PFS[match(RNA_ID, Checkmate_SE$RNA_ID)],
    status_PFS = Checkmate_SE$PFS_CNSR[match(RNA_ID, Checkmate_SE$RNA_ID)]
  )
tme_groups <- unique(Cox_df$survival_ecotype_gene)
cox_results <- lapply(tme_groups, function(group) {
  df_group <- Cox_df %>% filter(survival_ecotype_gene == group & !is.na(Arm))
  model <- coxph(Surv(PFS_months, status_PFS) ~ Arm, data = df_group)
  summary(model)
  })
names(cox_results) <- tme_groups
plot_df_prop <- rbind(data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[1]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3), 
                      type = names(cox_results[1])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[2]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[2])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[3]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[3]))
)

ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(type,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

## S11C

```{r}
# Define GOI of interest
GOI <- c("NFKB1", "CCND1", "MTOR", "VHL", "ICAM1", "CD44")
GOI_rel <- GOI[GOI %in% rownames(JAVELIN_SE)]

# Define heatmap based on normalized counts 
df <- t(assay(JAVELIN_SE)[GOI_rel,]) %>% as.data.frame 
df <- df %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
df$survival_ecotype_gene <- JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[match(df$PID, colnames(JAVELIN_SE))]
mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(df)-1), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(survival_ecotype_gene, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs))
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("survival_ecotype_gene")

## Create annotations
anno <- df %>% dplyr::select(survival_ecotype_gene) %>% group_by(survival_ecotype_gene) %>% dplyr::count()
anno <- anno[match(anno$survival_ecotype_gene, rownames(ht)),]
col_anno <- data.frame(gene = colnames(ht))
col_anno$cat <- ifelse(col_anno$gene %in% c("ICAM1", "CD44"), "poor", "good")
cat_col_sub <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "#CA0020"), c("good", "poor"))

## Print heatmap 
Heatmap(scale(ht), name = "Scaled mean Z-scores",
        column_split = col_anno$cat, 
        top_annotation = columnAnnotation(cat = anno_simple(col_anno$cat, col = cat_col_sub)), 
        show_column_dend = FALSE)+
  rowAnnotation(n = anno_barplot(anno$n, gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")))+
  rowAnnotation(anno = anno_text(anno$survival_ecotype_gene))
```

```{r}
# CNV arm-level burden
cnv_long <- as.data.frame(colData(Checkmate_SE)) %>%
  select(SUBJID, survival_ecotype_gene, starts_with("Amplification"), starts_with("Deletion")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("Amplification"), starts_with("Deletion")),
               names_to = "event", values_to = "status") %>%
  filter(status == "MUT")
cnv_burden <- cnv_long %>% group_by(SUBJID, survival_ecotype_gene) %>% dplyr::count(name = "CNV_burden")

# CNV burden 
ggplot(cnv_burden, aes(x = survival_ecotype_gene, y = CNV_burden, fill = survival_ecotype_gene))+
  geom_point(aes(color = survival_ecotype_gene))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_group)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_group)+
  theme_classic()+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("CNV_buren")+
  stat_compare_means()
```

## S12D

```{r}
# Create heatmap
plot_comp_surv <- comp_surv %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(Baseline, "vs", Test),
         log_p = -log10(p),
         direction = ifelse(Baseline == "Survival_Eco", "Eco as baseline", "Eco as test"))

mat <- plot_comp_surv %>%
  select(comparison, Dataset, log_p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = log_p) %>%
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>%
  as.matrix()
p_mat <- plot_comp_surv %>%
  select(comparison, Dataset, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = p) %>%
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>%
  as.matrix()
p_mat <- p_mat[rownames(mat), colnames(mat)]
row_dir <- plot_comp_surv$direction[match(rownames(mat), plot_comp_surv$comparison)]
row_dir <- factor(row_dir, levels = c("Eco as baseline", "Eco as test"))

## Plot
h <- Heatmap(mat,
        name = "-log10(p)",
        col = viridis(100),
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_split = row_dir,
        row_title_rot = 0,
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
          p <- p_mat[i, j]
          lbl <- if (is.na(p)) "" else if (p < 0.001) "***"
                 else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else if (p < 0.1) "°" else ""
          grid::grid.text(lbl, x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10))
        })

draw(h)
```

## S12E

```{r}
# Create heatmap
comp_IO <- comp_IO %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("ccRCC2", "ccRCC4", "ccRCC7", "eco")),
         surv  = factor(surv,  levels = c("OS", "PFS")),
         data = factor(data, levels = c("JAVELIN", "Immotion", "CheckMate")))

wide <- comp_IO %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(surv, group),
              names_from = data, values_from = fra_number)
mat <- wide %>% select(-surv, -group) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(mat) <- wide$group                       
row_surv <- wide$surv                           

## Plot
h <- Heatmap(mat,
        name = "fraction",
        col = viridis(100),
        row_split = row_surv,
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_title_rot = 0,
        row_names_side = "right",
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
          v <- mat[i, j]
          if (!is.na(v))
            grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", v), x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8))
        })

draw(h)
```
